fourier: C f(x)=2 integral_0^infinity cos(2 pi x xi) f(xi) dxi; the unitary cosine transform
outerRegulator: Z_R=P_R with R>=Lambda; in the correctly cycled trace Z_R^2 P_Lambda=P_Lambda

reference: J_0 f(x)=x^(-1) f(1/x), Q_Lambda^0=J_0 P_Lambda J_0=1_[Lambda^(-1),infinity); retain inversion explicitly
referenceEntry: Tr(P_Lambda Q_Lambda^0 A_i A_j*)=2 log(Lambda) integral p_i(u) conjugate(p_j(u)) du; zero for i!=j in this disjoint packet
evaluatedPairs: all ordered(i,j) with0<=i,j<=4 and i!=j; only the common diagonal remains uncomputed
method: Analytic kernel derivation plus exact rational interval bookkeeping; no sampled or synthetic operator matrices
